heroes.title: Homes, workplaces and property care
heroes.reason: Recommended direction: show the breadth of HQC in one view. Two earlier library photos sit alongside an archived workplace stock image.

heroes.title: People doing the work
heroes.reason: Makes the service visible instead of showing only an attractive room. Earlier library photograph; confirm the job and publication permission. A wider original would help the desktop crop.

heroes.title: Care in the detail
heroes.reason: A closer view of a person cleaning a window. Useful if the first impression should be hands-on care; balance with workplace and property imagery below.

heroes.title: A space ready to use
heroes.reason: Shows a clear, finished result using an earlier library image. Strong for occupation and handover, but residential on its own.

heroes.title: Ready for the next occupier
heroes.reason: An uncluttered room makes the result easy to see. Could support the managed-property story with nearby workplace and service evidence.

heroes.title: A professional workplace result
heroes.reason: An unbranded workplace image from the older site. A useful commercial counterweight; this is stock photography, not a claimed HQC client site.

feedback.document: HQC Website Copywriting Batch 1 – Pedro Approved Draft, implementation review
feedback.summary: The homepage should represent Property & Facilities, Workplaces and Homes. A strongly residential image risks making HQC look primarily like a luxury domestic-cleaning company. Balance it with workplace and managed-property imagery; use genuine HQC work where possible.
